notes:
More streams on screen at once.

The stream row now fits four to five sources across instead of three, and still scrolls left to right through the rest, so comparing them takes less scrolling. Each button carries the same detail as before, one attribute per line.

The focus highlight is fixed. It is now drawn on the edge of whatever is selected rather than just outside it, so it can no longer be cut off by the season list, the episode list, a poster row, the side menu or a dropdown - places where parts of it, and sometimes all of it, were previously invisible. It also follows rounded corners properly and stays aligned on cards that grow slightly when selected.
